meta.titre: Before leaving for China: the complete checklist
meta.note: English translation of checklist_depart_fr.json (to be reviewed). The [À VALIDER] markers and bracketed numbers are kept as is: the item stays hidden until validated.

items: Foreigner Physical Examination Form and test results
Original diplomas and transcripts, with their translations
8 ID photos on a white background
Paper copies and photos of all these documents on your phone
Plane ticket bought to arrive on the registration date shown on the Admission Notice
Flight and arrival time sent to Odysseo for the airport pick-up, at least [7] days before departure [À VALIDER]
University address written in Chinese (ask your advisor)
Registration at the university as soon as you arrive, then residence permit within 30 days
Enough money for the first month (housing if it is not free, insurance, residence permit, meals): your advisor gives you the amount for your city
WeChat app installed and account created before departure
Unlocked phone that accepts a Chinese SIM card
Warm clothes if your city has a cold winter (northern China)
